cohort: The study included data from 36,603 deliveries recorded in medical birth certificates in Croatia in 2019.
finding: The prevalence of labor induction in Croatia in 2019 was 14.1%, and it was associated with older maternal age, higher BMI, gestational weight gain above recommendations, various maternal health conditions, and adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with induced labor had a higher incidence of cesarean section and vacuum extraction.
